title: New Iron Extracting Method from Cattle's Blood for Iron Concentration Analysis
author: Khairil Asnan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6f2hbqe

steps.title: Compress Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Compress the whole blood sample from cattle using a mini-centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 6 mL of sample at 37 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix Blood with Sodium Hydroxide
steps.instruction: Mix the blood sample with 0.5 M Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH).

substeps.instruction: Combine 2 mL of blood sample with 2 mL of 0.5 M NaOH.

steps.title: Perform Chelate Reaction
steps.instruction: Add oleic acid to the mixed sample to initiate a chelate reaction and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL of Oleic acid to the previous mixed sample solution.
Let the mixture sit for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge the sample using a benchtop centrifuge.
